text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
One day, while stopping by the
shopping center...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Well, Tazuna, what do you think?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Um, well, I appreciate the invitation...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Good timing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Oh, Trainer! Good timing!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Can you please help me entice Tazuna?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! We ran into each other just as she
was
finishing an errand for the director.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
So I thought we could hang out together
and
chillax! But she isn't playing along...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
The director is waiting for me. I have to
go back
soon.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You're always so serious! Let your hair
down every
once in a while!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
It seems Maruzensky and Tazuna get
along quite well, despite their
relationship as student and
director's
assistant.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
You've been working nonstop lately.
Everyone is
worried about you!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Even so...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
C'mon, use that newfangled phone of
yours to
call the director up real
quick! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Just repeat after me, "I shall return
posthaste
after enjoying a lemonade at a
cafe with
Maruzensky!" ☆

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
A lemonade at a cafe... does sound
rather
wonderful...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, don't you think she should
have a
little fun?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Trainer, don't you think she should
have a
little fun?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Maruzensky comes on strong, but her
heart is in the right place. However, I
also know that Tazuna
is very serious
about her work...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, that's an interesting idea. Any
particular
reason?
choice_data_list: We could also take our time headin...
I think having a little fun wouldn...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
That's true... Chatting with friends can
put some
pep in your step.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Well said, Trainer! Let's make our way
back, then.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Hey, you say that like your bacon just
got saved!
Rude...

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Hehe... I know you're just worried about
me,
Maruzen. And I do appreciate the
concern.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Eh, it's no biggie. Anyway, enough of
the boring
chitchat...

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Wait until you hear this juicy
secret about
Tazuna! ♪

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Trainer! Wait until you hear this juicy
secret about
Tazuna! ♪

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: What?! What are you talking about?!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
The other day, I went to her room
unannounced,
and when I opened that
creaky closet of hers—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: MARUZENSKY!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, only joshing ya! Let's head
back! ♪

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We don't end up discussing any secrets,
but I get
a glimpse of just how close the
two of them are as
we walk home.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: See! It's agreed!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: See! It's agreed!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Why resist the inevitable? Have some
fun with
me!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Oh, very well. Only for ten minutes,
okay?

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text: Yaaay! You're mine now, Tazuna! ☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, your attendance will also be
required,
Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Of course, your attendance will also be
required,
Trainer!
choice_data_list: I'm well aware of what that entails.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you saw that coming, did you? You
know me
too well! ☆
choice_data_list: I'm well aware of what that entails.

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
Oh, you saw that coming, did you? You
know me
too well! ☆

text_block_list.name: Maruzensky
text_block_list.text:
All right, let's start with a little
shopping! And
away we gooo! ☆

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hey! Wait for us!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Hehe... As spirited as ever.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
The three of us end up walking around
the mall.
Although it's a little
exhausting, it's also a nice
break.
